description: Election Commission - Local Authorities Elections - 2024 - Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha. Notice under Section 66 B (1) .
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the declaration of appointed officials (Chairman and Vice Chairman) for a Local Authority (Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) in accordance with Section 66 B (1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with the results of an electoral process for local government, which falls squarely under the Elections classification (Type 7). While it names individuals, it does so in the context of declaring election/appointment results rather than detailing government ministerial portfolios or responsibilities, so it does not qualify for the government personnel types (2 or 3).
